title: Route-B structure derived from headings and generic dev prompt wording, with paid before/after check (REQ-0070)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 70.2 generic dev prompts, paid before/after check

design.summary: route-B structure_hint derived from route-A headings with a generic fallback; generic dev prompt wording (subject, level, language from the exam header); dev channel only; paid before/after check by the coordinator

implementation.summary: cross.structure_hint from route-A headings with a generic fallback, route-B IMAGE_RULES generic; generic dev prompt wording in five dev files; release channel untouched

unit_test.result: 1364 tests, only the 4 known baseline failures; release channel byte-identical across 114 inputs; dev and route-B prompts differ only in the intended sentences; 8 added tests, 7 mutations killed; structure_hint strict consistency rules; verifier D1 (vi verify_answer) fixed with a test

security.result: no finding; prompt wording and a pure text hint

verification.command: python3 -I -m unittest discover -s tests/unit; cross-solve real on the trial exam; regression set real solve on the dev channel; repeated physics/003
verification.result: REQ-0070 AC1, AC2 verified: 1364 tests, failures = the 4 known baseline names; release channel byte-identical; structure_hint strict (never states a wrong span: fallback otherwise); generic dev prompts; cross-solve agree 20 / needs_review 2 (before 19/3) with identical answer values; dev regset run 14 pass 1 fail 3 uncertain, the one new FAIL (physics/003 quote check) is a flake (3/3 PASS dev, 3/3 PASS release on repeat); limits: heading-derived hint tested on synthetic text only, one exam, no accuracy claim, genexam.md / genexam_qa.md / subjects/literature.md still fix a subject (out of scope)
